blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Human Digestive System) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define digestion and give its importance. Name the components of the human digestive system. (4 marks)
(Digestion ki definition aur ahmiyat likhein. Insaani digestive system ke hisson ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Digestion woh amal hai jis se jism ghiza ko chhote, jazb hone wale ajza mein torta hai.

Ahmiyat: yeh ghiza ko energy aur barhne, marammat aur jismani kaamon ki dekh bhaal ke maadde mein badalta hai; immune system ko sahara, zaroori ghizai ajza aur achhi sehat deta hai. Achha hazma ghizai kami se bachata, metabolism ko sahara deta aur energy qaim rakhta hai, is liye zindagi ke liye zaroori hai.

Hisse: insaani digestive system in se bana hai
1. gastrointestinal (GI) tract, mounh se anus tak musalsal naali: oral cavity, pharynx, oesophagus, stomach, small intestine aur large intestine;
2. accessory digestive organs: salivary glands, liver, gallbladder aur pancreas.

book_ref.quote: Digestion is crucial for converting food into energy and raw materials

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the functions performed by the oral cavity, including the composition of saliva. (4 marks)
(Oral cavity ke kaam, saliva ki banawat samait, bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Oral cavity mounh ke khulne ke foran baad ki khala hai. Hont (hissi nerve endings wale skeletal muscle) chabate waqt ghiza rokte aur phonation mein madad dete hain.

1. Ghiza ka intikhab: muscular zabaan taste buds se ghiza chakhti hai aur ghiza mehsoos hoti hai; na-pasand zaiqe ya boo wali, ya haddi ya mitti wali ghiza rad hoti hai. Soonghna aur dekhna bhi madad dete hain.

2. Mechanical hazma: daant mastication (chabane) se ghiza ko chhote tukron mein torte hain aur enzymes ke liye satah barhti hai.

3. Chemical hazma: salivary glands ke teen jore (sublingual zabaan ke neeche, submaxillary jabron ke peeche, parotid kaanon ke saamne) saliva dalte hain; taalu, zabaan aur gaal ise ghiza se milate hain.
Saliva mein paani aur mucus (ghiza ko geela aur chikna karte hain), bicarbonate ions (chemicals buffer karte hain), thiocyanate ions (jaraseem maarte hain) aur salivary amylase hai jo starch aur glycogen ko juzvi taur par maltose banata hai. Taaza saliva alkaline (pH 8) hai magar jaldi CO₂ kho kar pH 6 ho jata hai.

Phir ghiza chhota geela gola, bolus, ban jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The important functions performed by oral cavity are as follows

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe how food is swallowed and passed through the oesophagus into the stomach. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke ghiza kaise nigli jati hai aur oesophagus se stomach tak kaise pohanchti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Pharynx: mounh ke peeche khala, digestive aur respiratory raston ki mushtarka guzargah. Bolus mounh ke peeche dhakel kar pharynx se nigla jata hai.

Nigalna: zabaan mounh ki chhat ki taraf upar aur peeche jati hai aur bolus ko oral cavity ke peeche dhakelti hai. Soft palate pharynx ki pichli deewar se lag kar naak aur pharynx ka rasta band karta hai. Saath hi larynx upar uthta hai aur epiglottis (cartilage ka parda) neeche aa kar trachea ka munh band karta hai. Yun bolus trachea ke upar se guzar kar oesophagus mein jata hai. Nigalna ikhtiyari shuru hota hai magar ghiza mounh ke peeche pohanchne par khud-kaar ho jata hai.

Oesophagus: taqreeban 25 cm lambi naali jo pharynx ko stomach se jorti hai; is mein saliva ka amal jari rehta hai. Ghiza peristalsis se neeche jati hai. Lower oesophageal (cardiac) sphincter ghiza ke dabao par khul kar ise stomach mein jane deta hai aur stomach ki cheezon ko wapas aane se rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: During swallowing, the tongue moves upwards and backwards against the roof of the mouth

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the movements of the alimentary canal: peristalsis, segmentation, antiperistalsis and hunger contractions. (4 marks)
(Alimentary canal ki harkat bayan karein: peristalsis, segmentation, antiperistalsis aur hunger contractions.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Peristalsis: alimentary canal ki deewaron ki smooth muscles mein sukarne ki lehron ka bahaar-waar silsila. Yeh ghiza ko oesophagus aur naali ke doosre hisson mein aage dhakelta hai (Figure 9.5).

2. Segmentation: small aur large intestine mein smooth muscle ke challe baar baar sukarte aur dheele hote hain aur aik hi jagah aage peeche harkat banti hai. Yeh ghiza ko ratoobaton se milati aur jazb ko behtar karti hai.

3. Antiperistalsis: kabhi peristalsis ulti chalti hai aur ghiza ko intestines se wapas stomach aur mounh mein le aati hai, jis se ulti hoti hai.

4. Hunger contractions: khoon mein glucose kam hone se shuru hone wali peristaltic harkat jo bhook ki takleef (hunger pangs) deti hai.

book_ref.quote: The following two types of movements occur in alimentary canal

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the gastric glands and their secretory cells. Explain how pepsin is formed and how the stomach lining is protected from its own secretions. (4 marks)
(Gastric glands aur un ke kharij karne wale cells bayan karein. Batayein ke pepsin kaise banta hai aur stomach ki parat apni ratoobaton se kaise bachti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Gastric glands: stomach ki mucosa mein be-shumar naali numa gastric glands hain jo gehre garhon, gastric pits, se khulte hain. Har gland mein epithelial cells aur teen kharij karne wale cells hain:
1. Mucous cells: mucus kharij karte hain, gaarhi ratoobat jo stomach ki andaruni satah dhak kar HCl aur enzymes se bachati hai.
2. Parietal (oxyntic) cells: hydrochloric acid kharij karte hain jo pH taqreeban 2-3 karta, ghiza naram karta, pepsinogen ko active karta aur jaraseem maarta hai.
3. Chief cells: enzyme pepsinogen kharij karte hain.
Yeh sab mil kar gastric juice hain. Bachon mein is mein rennin zyada hota hai jo doodh ke proteins jama kar doodh ko der se aage jane deta hai taake doosre enzymes unhein hazam kar saken.

Pepsin ka banna: HCl ke H⁺ ions pepsinogen ko pepsin banate hain jo proteins ko polypeptides aur peptides mein torta hai.

Hifazat: baghair hifazat ke mucosa acid aur pepsin se kharab ho jati; is ki hifazat do tareeqon se hai, gaarhe mucus aur bicarbonate se jo acid ko neutral karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The mucosa of stomach possesses numerous tubular gastric glands

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the digestion of food in the duodenum, including the action of the enzymes of pancreatic juice and the role of bile. (4 marks)
(Duodenum mein ghiza ka hazma bayan karein, pancreatic juice ke enzymes ke amal aur bile ke kirdar samait.)
blocks.explanation:
Duodenum small intestine ke pehle 20-25 cm hain aur hazme se mutaliq hai. Is ke glands bicarbonate wali alkaline ratoobat banate hain. Is mein do bari ratoobatein aati hain:

a. Pancreatic juice: pancreas ki ratoobat, bicarbonate ki wajah se halki alkaline (pH 8); chyme ki acidity neutral karti hai. Is ke enzymes:
Pancreatic amylase: polysaccharides se maltose balke glucose.
Trypsinogen: ghair-active; duodenum ki deewar ka enterokinase ise trypsin banata hai jo proteins ko polypeptides mein torta hai.
Chymotrypsin aur carboxypeptidase: proteins se chhote peptides aur phir amino acids.
Pancreatic lipase: lipids se glycerol aur fatty acids.
Pancreatic nucleases: DNA aur RNA se nucleotides.

b. Bile: liver ki ratoobat, nikalne se pehle gallbladder mein jama. Charbi hal nahi hoti aur lipase is par asaani se asar nahi karta. Bile salts detergent ka kaam karte hain: charbi ko chhote qatron mein emulsify kar ke alag rakhte hain aur lipid hazam karne wale enzymes ko bari satah dete hain.

book_ref.quote: It is concerned with the digestion of food

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe the jejunum and ileum and the enzymes of intestinal juice with their actions. (4 marks)
(Jejunum aur ileum aur intestinal juice ke enzymes ka amal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Jejunum: duodenum ke baad taqreeban 2.4 m lamba. Ileum: small intestine ka aakhri teen-paanchwan hissa, taqreeban 3.5 m. Yeh baqi hazma aur ghiza ka jazb karte hain; in ki andaruni deewar par villi wali bari gol tahein hain.

In ki deewaron ke glands intestinal juice kharij karte hain jis ke enzymes:
Aminopeptidase: polypeptides se dipeptides.
Erepsin: dipeptides se amino acids.
Lipase: fats se fatty acids aur glycerol.
Maltase: maltose se glucose.
Sucrase: sucrose se glucose aur fructose.
Lactase: lactose se glucose aur galactose.

In enzymes ke baad chyme alkaline emulsion, chyle, ban jata hai jis ki aakhri paidawar jejunum aur ileum mein jazb hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: These parts carry out the rest of digestion and absorption of food

blocks.prompt:
8 Trace the digestion of proteins along the alimentary canal, naming each enzyme, where it acts and its product. (4 marks)
(Alimentary canal mein proteins ke hazme ka safar bayan karein, har enzyme, us ki jagah aur paidawar ke saath.)
blocks.explanation: Proteins stomach se small intestine tak qadam ba qadam hazam hote hain yahan tak ke amino acids ban jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Pepsin catalyses the breakdown of proteins to yield polypeptides and peptides

rows: Pepsin (chief cells ka pepsinogen, HCl ke H⁺ se active)
Doodh ke proteins jamata aur der se aage jane deta hai
Trypsin (pancreatic juice ka trypsinogen, enterokinase se active)
Proteins se chhote peptides aur phir amino acids

blocks.prompt:
9 Trace the digestion of carbohydrates along the alimentary canal, naming each enzyme, where it acts and its product. (4 marks)
(Alimentary canal mein carbohydrates ke hazme ka safar bayan karein, har enzyme, us ki jagah aur paidawar ke saath.)
blocks.explanation: Carbohydrates ka hazma oral cavity se shuru ho kar small intestine mein monosaccharides par khatam hota hai jo jazb ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Saliva also contains an enzyme, salivary amylase

rows: Starch aur glycogen ko juzvi taur par maltose

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the structure of a villus. Compare the routes by which absorbed glucose and absorbed fatty acids reach the blood. (4 marks)
(Villus ki banawat bayan karein. Jazb shuda glucose aur jazb shuda fatty acids ke khoon tak pohanchne ke raston ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Villus ki banawat: jejunum aur ileum ki andaruni deewar par bari gol tahein hain jin par be-shumar ungli numa villi hain (satah makhmali lagti hai). Har villus mein khoon ki baareek naaliyan aur lymph naali, lacteal, hai jo aik cell moti epithelium se dhaki hain. Epithelial cells par be-shumar cytoplasmic ubhaar, microvilli, hain. Villi aur microvilli jazb ki satah ko behad bara banate hain.

Dono raston ka muqabla table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: These folds have numerous finger-like projections called villi

rows: Diffusion ya active transport se villi ke epithelial cells mein
Passive transport se villi ke epithelial cells mein
Villi ki khoon ki naaliyon mein jate hain
Triglycerides ban kar proteins se lipat-te hain, chylomicrons bante hain jo lacteals mein jate hain
Naaliyan mil kar hepatic portal vein banati hain jo inhein liver tak le jati hai
Chylomicrons thoracic lymphatic duct aur phir khoon mein jate hain
Liver zaa'id glucose ko glycogen aur amino acids ko proteins bana kar rakhta hai; zaroori miqdaar hepatic vein se dil tak
Plasma ke enzymes chylomicrons ko fats aur proteins mein torte hain; fats fatty acids aur glycerol ban kar cells mein jate hain

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe the structure and functions of the three parts of the large intestine. (4 marks)
(Large intestine ke teen hisson ki banawat aur kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Large intestine alimentary canal ka aakhri hissa hai, small intestine se kaafi chhoti (taqreeban aakhri aik meter). Yeh bal-daar nahi aur is mein villi nahi. Yeh paani, salts aur vitamin K khoon mein jazb karti hai.

1. Caecum: ileum aur colon ke darmiyan band thaili. Is ke band sire se ungli numa vermiform appendix nikalta hai jo insaan mein be-kaar (vestigial) hai. Is ki sozish (appendicitis, aam taur par bacteria se) mein operation (appendicectomy) zaroori hai warna yeh phat kar pet ki parat mein sozish phaila sakta hai.

2. Colon: caecum ke baad, ascending, transverse aur descending hisson wala. Is ka bara kaam paani jazb karna hai, is liye baqi maadda sakht faeces ban jata hai: bacteria, na hazam paudon ke reshe (cellulose), na hazam ghiza, jhari mucosa cells, bile pigments aur paani. Yahan E. coli jaise bacteria amino acids aur vitamin K (khoon jamne ke liye zaroori) banate hain.

3. Rectum: aakhri hissa jahan faeces aarzi taur par jama hote hain; yeh anus se khulta hai jis ke gird smooth muscle ka andaruni aur striated muscle ka bairooni sphincter hai. Bhara rectum defecation reflex paida karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
12 Explain the control of egestion and compare it in infants and adults. (4 marks)
(Egestion ke control ki wazahat karein aur bachon aur baligh mein is ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Rectum faeces jama karta hai; bhar jaye to defecation reflex paida hota hai. Anus ka andaruni sphincter smooth muscle aur bairooni striated muscle ka hai. Bachon ka ghair-ikhtiyari reflex aur baligh ka ikhtiyari control nervous aur muscular nashonuma ke do marahil hain; barhte hue bacha is reflex ko apne ikhtiyar mein lana seekhta hai. Yeh tabdeeli reflex raston ka shaoori control se milna hai jo samaji aur mahauli zarooraton ke mutabiq hai.

book_ref.quote: The involuntary reflex for egestion in infants and the voluntary control in adults

rows: Pukhta cerebral cortex control karta hai
Ikhtiyari control ke dimaghi markaz abhi poore nahi bane
Rectum phailne par andaruni anal sphincter khud dheela aur fuzla kharij
Bairooni anal sphincter ka shaoori control defecation ko rokta ya shuru karta hai

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the position and the exocrine and endocrine parts of the pancreas, and explain the hormonal control of the secretions of pancreas and liver. (4 marks)
(Pancreas ki jagah aur us ke exocrine aur endocrine hisse bayan karein, aur pancreas aur liver ki ratoobaton ka hormonal control samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pancreas: bara gland; insaan mein stomach ke peeche (dorsal) duodenum ke mor mein (kitaab ki durusti).
Exocrine (naali wala) hissa: pancreatic juice pancreatic duct mein dalta hai jo liver ki common bile duct se mil kar duodenum mein khulti hai. Juice mein har qisam ki ghiza ke enzymes hain: trypsin, chymotrypsin, lipases, amylases, nucleases.
Endocrine (be-naali) hissa: hormones insulin aur glucagon extracellular fluid mein kharij karta hai jahan se yeh qareebi capillaries mein jate hain.

Hormonal control: pancreatic juice aur bile ka nikalna duodenum ki deewar ke hormones control karte hain.
Tezabi chyme duodenum mein aaye to us ki acidity duodenum ki deewar se secretin nikalwati hai.
Chyme ke juzvi hazam proteins aur fats duodenum ki deewar se cholecystokinin (CCK) nikalwate hain.
Yeh hormones pancreas se pancreatic juice aur gallbladder se bile (jo liver banata hai) bile duct ke zariye nikalwate hain.

book_ref.quote: The release of secretions from pancreas and liver is also controlled by hormones

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the storage and metabolic roles of the liver. (4 marks)
(Liver ke zakheera karne aur metabolic kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Zakheera: liver ghiza ke zaa'id ajza jama karta hai aur jism ko energy ya tameeri maadde ki zaroorat ho to chhorta hai:
glucose (glycogen ki shakal mein); vitamins A, D, B₁₂ aur K; iron aur copper jaise minerals; fats aur charbi mein hal hone wale maadde. Hepatic portal vein se aaye zaa'id amino acids bhi proteins bana kar rakhta hai.

Metabolic kirdar: yeh maaddon ko torta, banata aur badalta hai:
1. Zaa'id glucose ko glycogen aur zaroorat par wapas glucose banata hai.
2. Charbi tor kar energy deta aur cholesterol aur lipoproteins banata hai.
3. Amino acids badalta aur nuqsan-deh ammonia ko urea banata hai jo peshaab mein kharij hoti hai.
4. Khoon se zehreele maadde, adwiyat aur alcohol tor kar nikalta hai.
5. Hormones ko torta aur control karta hai.
Hazme mein yeh bile bhi banata hai jo charbi ko emulsify karti hai, aur proteins banata hai.

book_ref.quote: The liver performs many important functions, especially in storing nutrients and regulating metabolism
